sqlMap.select: SELECT HD.DEPTNO, HDNAME.CONTENT DEPT_NAME, HD.PARENT_DEPT_NO, '0' AS ISCHECKED FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HD, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDNAME WHERE HD.PARENT_DEPT_NO = '0' AND HD.DEPTNO = HDNAME.DEPTNO(+) AND HDNAME.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#

SELECT HD.DEPTNO, HDNAME.CONTENT DEPT_NAME, HD.PARENT_DEPT_NO, HD.DEPT_LEVEL, (CASE WHEN T.DEPTNO IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ISCHECKED, (CASE WHEN HD.DEPT_LEVEL > 2 THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END) AS ISEXPAND FROM ( SELECT T.*, ROWNUM RN FROM HR_DEPARTMENT T WHERE T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# START WITH T.PARENT_DEPT_NO = '0' CONNECT BY PRIOR T.DEPTNO = T.PARENT_DEPT_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY T.ORDERNO, T.DEPT_LEVEL DESC, T.DEPTID) HD, PA_SUPERVISOR_INFO T, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDNAME WHERE HD.DEPTNO = T.DEPTNO(+) AND T.PERSON_ID(+) = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND HD.DEPTNO = HDNAME.DEPTNO(+) AND HDNAME.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#

SELECT HD.DEPTNO, HDNAME.CONTENT DEPT_NAME, HD.PARENT_DEPT_NO, HD.DEPT_LEVEL, 0 ISCHECKED, (CASE WHEN HD.DEPT_LEVEL > 2 THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END) AS ISEXPAND FROM ( SELECT T.*, ROWNUM RN FROM HR_DEPARTMENT T WHERE T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND T.ACTIVITY = 1 START WITH T.PARENT_DEPT_NO = '0' CONNECT BY PRIOR T.DEPTNO = T.PARENT_DEPT_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY T.ORDERNO, T.DEPT_LEVEL DESC, T.DEPTID) HD, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDNAME WHERE HD.DEPTNO = HDNAME.DEPTNO(+) AND HDNAME.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# ORDER BY HD.RN

SELECT distinct D.DEPTID, D.ORDERNO, D.DEPT_LEVEL, D.DEPTNO, D.PARENT_DEPT_NO, TO_CHAR(D.DATE_CREATED, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS DATE_CREATED, (SELECT get_dept_name(D2.deptno,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D2 WHERE D2.DEPTNO = D.PARENT_DEPT_NO AND D2.CPNY_ID=#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#) AS PARENT_DEPT_NAME, get_dept_name(D.deptno,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) AS DEPTNAME, DECODE(C.DEPTNO,'','false','true') CHECKED FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D, (SELECT DEPTNO FROM PA_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE PERSON_ID = #PA_SUPERVISOR_ID:VARCHAR#) C WHERE (D.DATE_CREATED < SYSDATE AND D.DATE_ENDED > SYSDATE OR D.DATE_ENDED IS NULL) AND D.CPNY_ID=#interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND D.DEPTNO = C.DEPTNO(+) AND D.USE_YN='Y' START WITH D.PARENT_DEPT_NO = '0' AND D.CPNY_ID=#interCpnyID:VARCHAR# CONNECT BY PRIOR D.DEPTNO = D.PARENT_DEPT_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY D.ORDERNO, D.DEPT_LEVEL DESC, D.DEPTNO
